label: Bible Study
prompt: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may _____ that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
verse: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
note: Not hope-so but know-so — John wrote this letter for assurance.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the _____, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verse: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
note: After exile: young and old dancing together, mourning turned into joy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the _____ with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
verse: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
note: Luke's version of the roof story: the friends lowered the sick man through the tiling, couch and all, right before Jesus.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a _____.
verse: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.
note: Naaman had rank, victories and the king's favor — and one word that undid it all, until a captive Israelite girl spoke up.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the manna was as _____ seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
verse: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
note: Manna looked like 'coriander' seed and tasted like wafers made with honey (Exodus 16:31) — and Israel still complained.
